description: Search European Court of Human Rights (ECHR / Strasbourg) case law by free text, Convention Article, respondent state and/or date. Returns case name, application number(s), Article(s) engaged, the conclusion (violation/no violation), importance level and the itemid to read the full judgment with echr_judgment. Use for "what has Strasbourg ruled on Article 8 against France", "recent Article 10 freedom-of-expression judgments", etc. Covers judgments by default; pass collection to search decisions, advisory opinions, resolutions, communicated cases or reports instead.

article.description: Convention Article number, e.g. "8" (private/family life), "10" (freedom of expression), "6" (fair trial). Matches the Article and its sub-paragraphs.

collection.description: Document type to search (default "judgments"). "decisions" = admissibility decisions; "communicated_cases" = pending cases the Court has notified the government of, no ruling yet.

date_from.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only documents on or after this date.

date_to.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only documents on or before this date.

importance.description: HUDOC importance level: 1 = highest (leading cases), 4 = lowest. Omit for all.

query.description: Free-text words to match anywhere in the case (case name, conclusion text, keywords), e.g. "surveillance", "freedom of expression". Optional if article/respondent narrow enough on their own.

respondent.description: Respondent state — ISO3 code (e.g. "FRA", "GBR") or common name (e.g. "France", "United Kingdom"). One of the 46 Council of Europe states, or Russia for pre-2022 cases.

name: echr_search

count.description: Number of results returned in this response.

note.description: Present ONLY when results is empty: how to broaden the query. Its presence means zero matches, not an error.

query.description: Echo of the resolved filters actually sent to HUDOC, after country-name and date normalisation.

article.description: Convention Article filter applied, or null.

collection.description: Document collection searched: judgments, decisions, advisory_opinions, resolutions, communicated_cases or reports.

importance.description: Importance level filter (1 = leading case, 4 = lowest), or null.

respondent.description: Respondent state as the ISO3 code HUDOC uses (e.g. "FRA"), resolved from the caller's input, or null.

article.description: Semicolon-separated Convention Articles engaged, including sub-paragraphs, e.g. "8;8-1;8-2".

case_name.description: Case title, e.g. "CASE OF DRELON v. FRANCE".

citation_url.description: Public hudoc.echr.coe.int URL for the document.

conclusion.description: The Court's conclusion in its own words, e.g. "Violation of Article 8 ..." or "No violation of Article 8 ...".

doctype.description: HUDOC document type code, e.g. "HEJUD" (Chamber/Grand Chamber judgment).

itemid.description: HUDOC document id, e.g. "001-219226". Pass to echr_judgment for the full text.

read_full_text_with.description: Ready-to-run echr_judgment call that returns this document's full text.

source.description: Attribution string for the HUDOC database.

total_matches.description: Total documents in HUDOC matching the query, which is usually far larger than count — page with limit.

title: Echr Search
